title: L-bracket
blurb: Single part, six parameters. Drag a slider or fillet an edge — both are written back as code.

title: Pi mount (3 files)
blurb: Every file is a component. The assembly imports the plate and the standoff like any TypeScript module.

title: Bearing flange
blurb: A 608 bearing seat and a counterbored bolt circle, from the standard library in two calls.

title: Wall shelf (assembly)
blurb: Four parts placed with mates, and a left-hand bracket mirrored into a right-hand one.
